title: 第25章 吃顿好的第26章 帮你请假
lines: 第25章吃顿好的
“我们先跑两圈热一下身。”乔桑接着说道。
火牙狗戴上负重环后适应的还算快，走路基本瞧着已经没什么问题，但都是负重走路的话起不了什么特别明显的训练效果。
火牙狗点点头，对乔桑的安排没有异议。
这次乔桑选择跟火牙狗一起跑。
在乔桑的鼓励下，火牙狗艰难地跑完两圈后，它满脸生无可恋地看向乔桑。
你管这叫热身？
乔桑喘着粗气，两圈跑下来，她这身板也有点吃不消。
看来以后还是要锻炼一下……
等乔桑气息恢复过来，拿出手机看了看跑步记下的时间。
早上晨跑的时候火牙狗一圈平均大概用了18分钟。
现在加上负重环后第一圈是29分03秒，第二圈是38分42秒。
乔桑用手机的备忘录记了下来，准备到时候比较下跑步的时间。
“热身结束了，接下来对着这棵树使用十次猛撞。”乔桑带着火牙狗来到早上她看书的梧桐树下。
火牙狗听到这话一屁股坐在地上，虚弱地叫了一声。
“难道你不想变强吗？”乔桑问道。
她跟火牙狗这几天相处下来，知道它的个性要强，意志力这一块也很不错，虽然只跟别人对战过四次，但每一次都冲到最前面不会害怕受伤。
变强？
火牙狗慢慢起身，眼神也变得坚韧起来。
它当初契约不就是为了出来变强找更多的对手吗？
乔桑很满意火牙狗的眼神变化，她想起当初第一次见到火牙狗的场景。
那时候火牙狗用它那幼小的身体不停撞击着树干，也是现在这样坚韧的眼神。
现在想起，好像有种过了很久的感觉。
“说不定这次训练你还能练成上次想练的技能。”乔桑笑道。
火牙狗看着自家御兽师满脸问号。
“就我第一次在宠兽基地见到你的时候你想练的技能。”乔桑解释道。
火牙狗更加迷茫了。
它什么时候有想练的技能了？
“你没想学的技能你撞树干嘛？难不成是在练习猛撞？”乔桑也茫然了。
不应该啊，猛撞起码得五米开外跑着助力，她记得火牙狗上次就在树下一米以内撞击着。
火牙狗回想起跟自家御兽师的第一次见面。
那时候它在干嘛？

Chapter 25 Have a good meal
"Let's run two laps to warm up first," Qiao Sang continued.
The Fire Tooth Dog adapted fairly quickly after wearing the weight-bearing ring, and basically seemed to have no problem walking. However, walking with weight-bearing would not have any particularly obvious training effect.
"Teeth."
Fire Tooth Dog nodded and had no objection to Qiao Sang's arrangement.
This time Qiao Sang chose to run with the Fire Tooth Dog.
With Qiao Sang's encouragement, after the Fire Tooth Dog ran two difficult laps, it looked at Qiao Sang with a despairing look on its face.
You call this a warm-up?
Qiao Sang panted heavily and ran down two laps. Her body was a bit overwhelmed.
It seems that I still need to exercise in the future...
After Qiao Sang regained his breath, he took out his phone and looked at the time recorded during his run.
During the morning jog, it took the Fire Tooth Dog around 18 minutes on average to complete one lap.
Now after adding the weight ring, the first lap is 29 minutes and 03 seconds, and the second lap is 38 minutes and 42 seconds.
Qiao Sang wrote it down in the memo on his phone, preparing to compare the running times.
"The warm-up is over. Next, use ten slams against this tree." Qiao Sang took the fire-toothed dog to the sycamore tree where she read in the morning.
"Teeth~"
After hearing this, Fire Tooth Dog sat down on the ground and gave a weak cry.
"Don't you want to become stronger?" Qiao Sang asked.
After spending the past few days with Firefang Dog, she knew that it had a strong personality and a good willpower. Although she had only fought against others four times, she always rushed to the front without fear of injury.
Become stronger?
Fire Tooth Dog slowly stood up, his eyes becoming tough.
Wasn't it originally contracted to become stronger and find more opponents?
Qiao Sang was very satisfied with the change in Fire Tooth Dog's eyes. She recalled the scene when she saw Fire Tooth Dog for the first time.
At that time, the fire-toothed dog kept hitting the tree trunk with its young body, and it also had the same tough look in its eyes now.
Thinking about it now, it feels like a long time has passed.
"Maybe you can practice the skills you wanted to practice last time during this training." Qiao Sang said with a smile.
"Teeth?"
Huoya Dog looked at his beast master with questions on his face.
"Just the skills you wanted to practice when I first met you at the pet beast base." Qiao Sang explained.
"Teeth?"
Fire Tooth Dog became even more confused.
When did it have the skills it wanted to practice?
"Why are you hitting the tree for the skill you didn't want to learn? Could it be that you are practicing slamming into it?" Qiao Sang was also confused.
It shouldn't be. The collision had to be at least five meters away and running to help. She remembered that the last time the fire-toothed dog hit the tree was within one meter.
Firefang Dog recalled the first meeting with his beast master.
What was it doing at that time?
